articles.title: 55 Years, 55 Tracks: How the Labèque Sisters Keep Reinventing the Piano Duo
articles.summary: Katia and Marielle Labèque refused to split up in 1969, and that stubbornness launched a legendary piano duo. Their new triple album 55 marks over five decades with a bold twist: nearly half the tracks are new, spotlighting long-overlooked women composers. It's a treasure trove of ferocious two-piano battles and intimate four-handed whispers.

articles.title: How a Pair of White Sneakers Makes Emily Blunt the Perfect Sci-Fi Heroine
articles.summary: In Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day, Emily Blunt's meteorologist Margaret Fairchild wears glamorous dresses on air but practical sneakers underneath. Costume designer Paul Tazewell uses that footwear to telegraph her pragmatism and relatability—crucial when aliens arrive and she needs to run. It's a quiet rebellion against Hollywood's impractical shoe obsession.
